summary_en: Sumitomo Seika Chemicals will cancel 739,800 shares (1.1% of issued shares before cancellation) on October 30, 2026, reducing issued shares to 63,969,485.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On September 28, 2026, Sumitomo Seika Chemicals announced the cancellation of 739,800 treasury shares held pursuant to a Board resolution from May 12, 2026. The cancellation is scheduled for October 30, 2026. These shares represent 1.1% of issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will be reduced to 63,969,485.
